why: The on-demand gate is the point of option B: the check costs ~0.2 s per 10,000 titles. Must fail on the before-the-click test.

name: the auto setting is ignored
why: sa_findings_title_style_auto would then do nothing. Must fail on the auto-setting test.

name: the WARNING menu never offers the check
why: Without the row there is no way to run the check. Must fail on the before-the-click test.

edits.find: if (!_titleStyleActive()) return { done: false, text: 'Check title style (MB guidelines)' };

grep: nothing is checked before the click

name: the click does not turn the findings on
why: The re-stamp then runs with the findings still disabled. Must fail on the stamped-titles test.

name: the menu is created only when a finding has rows
why: On a page with no other warning the check row would never show. The fixture page has no other warning, so must fail on the before-the-click test.

name: the title-style tint setting is ignored
why: sa_findings_tint_title_style would then not turn the paint off. Must fail on the tint-setting test.
grep: keep the finding but not the paint

name: a finding's own setting is ignored
why: sa_findings_title_typography would then not turn its finding off. Must fail on the own-setting test.

name: the case comparison is dropped
why: The hover card then shows the label alone, no title over MB style. Must fail on the hover-card test.

name: the language gate is gone
why: Spanish and Yiddish titles would be re-cased. Must fail on the shared cases.

name: the sentence-case gate is gone
why: "Bolji nego ja" and "songs without a home" would be re-cased. Must fail on the shared cases.

name: phrasal short prepositions are judged
why: "Take On Me" and "Plug In Baby" would be flagged. Must fail on the shared cases.

name: "The" after "&" is judged
why: "Bruce Springsteen & The E Street Band" would be flagged. Must fail on the stamped-titles test (a fixture title) and the shared cases.

name: typography reads inside [...]
why: File names such as "[80's Prom Night 12.mp3]" would be flagged. Must fail on the shared cases.

name: the series rule fires after "&"
why: "Greatest Hits, Volume I & Volume II" would get a comma before its second volume. Must fail on the shared cases.
